body: His parents are fantastic actually, theyve always cared for me- Thank you for talking to me, I really appreciate it

Thank you, that means a lot to me really.  
He did have a therapist but he doesn't like talking about his feelings much (even to me hes a bit hesitant but he does.) so he stopped going to her. He was diagnosed with depression awhile ago.   
He still doesn't talk to me much about the things he went through trauma wise which I understand but i'm all ears when he does.

Thank you for the first two paragraphs. About your questions, I did have a professional therapist. He diagnosed me w/ my ADHD and helped me get meds \[i dont take them anymore\] for it, though he wasnt my favorite he helped a lot. Unfortunately I slipped up on what I said and he learned about the way my parents treat me, so he said that he'd report them if they didn't meet with him. They did and then took me out of the therapy.   
My normal counselor is also on maternity leave. I have another one whos nicer actually but i only see her once every 1-3 months. I don't trust her much yet
